title: Report 82683: Report # 82683
summary: This happened around 10PM. I was driving with my husband and kids on the rural roads near Bass River. We drove along Route 542. As we rounded the bend where Loveland Lane merges into Route 542 (you can see the Loveland Ln street sign when going around the bend on the left side of the road) I became terrified in a matter of seconds. Our high beams illuminated a massive figure up ahead stepping out from the right side of the road. I stepped on the brakes to slow down. It stood about 8 feet tall. It was bulky, heavily built GIANT frame. It was covered in jet-black fur and it appeared to be soaking wet. Our headlights were reflecting off its fur. I saw enough detail to distinguish human-like hands and unusually long arms. It walked with a slight hunch but moved at fast speed. It didnt take many steps for it to get across the road. Thing moved fast enough to look like it was gliding without actually gliding. Its arms swung like a human walks but with heavy reach. I asked my husband if he was seeing the same thing I was ... He confirmed that he saw it. It cleared the span of Route 542 and vanished into the darkness. Thankfully our children slept through it in the back seat. I sped out of the area. I called my mother after we were some distance away. I told her what we had just witnessed. On the drive back home Jason [husband] told me about what we saw. Before then I knew almost nothing of a Bigfoot or a Sasquatch. I saw this giant creature with my own eyes. We know what we saw. It was definitely about 8 feet tall.

title: Report 82698: Report # 82698
summary: I was working in Devore,California and every morning  I would get a coffee and a muffin and would ride my motorcycle up Palm Ave. off 215 freeway until it became a forest road. On May 21, 2024 at about 5:15 AM, I had parked my motorcycle and was standing next to it when I could hear some "talking". I thought my bluetooth headset had came back on as I still had my helmet on, but it wasn't. So I took my helmet off to listen to whoever was coming toward me.The talking I heard was from 2 distinct and different voices. thats when I noticed it wasn't any language I had ever heard. It was a gibberish that didn't produce any real words. the voices weren't exceptionally loud and were probably only about 20 to 30 yards from me. I have grown up in and around the Fontana  San Bernardino, high desert area and was a small child when the Fontana raceway incident of 1975 occurred, we only lived 2 miles from there at the time. So I have been aware of all the sasquatch sightings around the area. I proceeded to act like a gorilla and make ape like growls and at that point the gibberish ceased. I made very loud growls and jumped around throwing sticks and dirt in the air. after 30 or 40 seconds there was no sound so I quit what I was doing and proceeded to quietly drink my coffee and eat my muffin. After a couple of minutes I heard another Sasquatch about half a mile away "call" to the two near me. I left part of my muffin on a rock near me as a gift to them. Mind you this time of the morning it was very dark,and you can only see about 150 to 200 feet in any direction. I went there everyday before and after the incident. After about 3 days after the incident my gifts were no longer being taken... they had moved on. These are the GPS coordinates where this incident took place. 34.21983995539393, -117.33986248200914

title: Report 82711: Report # 82711
summary: My husband and I had just hiked up the incline on December 28th and got to the top around 2pm. We were hiking back down Barr trail after about a 30 minute break at the top. On our way down when we got to the part of the trail where you can see the creek and the train tracks, we both saw a very large shadowy figure walking down on the other side of the tracks. We both stopped to look at each other to see if we had both witnessed the same thing, and then when we looked back the figure had completely disappeared. We both confirmed we had witnessed the same thing and werent insane. We were confused because there's no easy access over the creek, and no trail in the area we saw the figure. We stood around for a few minutes to see if it would pop back up but it never did. We took a selfie with the area we had seen the figure in behind us but the shadowy figure is not seen in the picture. Just the location he appeared in. We didn't know about the BFRO and to report it until our sons told us about it so we are now making an official report.

summary: I was doing an evening deer hunt ~10mi SE of St. Maries in the mountains. I was walking down a trail, and from what sounded about 200-300 yards away in a creek bed I heard loud knocking on a tree immediately followed by a super strong smell of death. The knocking persisted for 5-10 minutes, and upon searching for any carcasses producing the smell, nothing was found. I also heard briefly what sounded like a really deep voice but I couldn't make out what it was saying, sort of gibberish. I did not see any human footprints or any signs of people on that trail or in the general area. I was the only truck I saw all day on the road leading to the drainage I was in.

title: Report 79580: Report # 79580

Only a handful of people even know this part of the river exists. There is absolutely no public access. I have picutres of the tracks and I would like to send them to you. My twin wears a size 11 women's and some of the tracks were bigger and some small, I believe there was an adult and juvenile bigfoot.

title: Report 82613: Report # 82613
summary: It was opening day of deer season. It was the middle of Oct. I was with a friend. We hunted the lower Hoh in the morning. The road is called Oil City Rd. My friend said it was running on two legs. Both of us did not believe in them until that day. It was sunny and clear. We know what we saw.

title: Report 84713: Report # 84713
summary: In the summer of 1989 I worked at a radio station in Johnstown, Pa. I didnt have a car so my father would drive me to work and I would walk home. It was about a six mile walk (can you say "hot girl summer"?!).  It was late July and I remember that on the way to work there was a dead skunk. I had to remember that for my walk home so I could run by it. This particular day was unusually hot. I changed out of my work clothes and put them into my backpack, put my favorite mixed tape in my Walkman and headed down Singer Hill toward the city of Johnstown. The road was heavily wooded on both sides, but more so the left. As I got further away from houses and into the woods I began to have a weird feeling, like I was being watched.  I heard a knock on the metal guardrail. I remember taking off my headphones and putting them in my backpack; thinking that maybe the heat had caused the metal to expand causing it to make a sound. Soon I heard another knock, but this time it sounded like it was further in front of me, downhill. By this time my guard was up and I started walking faster. Soon I smelled the most awful smell of my life! I knew it wasnt the dead skunk from the morning as I was no where near it. Suddenly I heard something across the street and up the hill to my right. I turned to look as I saw trees moving left and right being pushed aside. I was frozen with fear as a tall huge shadow stopped running and ducked down. I was still trying to see what was causing the commotion when I noticed white fur moving, then I made eye contact with this thing!!! It was looking at me as I was looking at it!!! Every hair on my body stood up and the adrenaline rush was like NOTHING Ive ever experienced again in my life! I ran for my life! The smell didnt subside until I got to the dead skunk, at which point I tried to stop running and just walk, but my body refused and continued to sprint. title: Report 84698: Report # 84698
summary: Sorry for the long story, but I feel the need to make readers understand how isolated a place Lake of the Woods (LOTW) was during the time my experiences took place. I recently watched the "Sierra Sounds" documentary on YouTube and discovered the BFRO site. After reading through it, I felt compelled to share my two stories. My family started going camping at Webber Lake in Sierra County, California, every summer in the late 60s. I was born in '73. We lived in the SF bay area, so it was a reasonably short drive for a weekend camping trip. As Webber Lake became more crowded, we started going to Lake of the Woods more and more. Back then, LOTW was as primitive as you could get. No bathrooms, no boat ramp, no picnic tables. Fires were not allowed, but we always had one anyway as the Rangers never drove out there and my dad was never big on being told what he could or couldn't do. The campsites were generously spaced out, with lots of small trees and dense undergrowth providing privacy between sites. We had experienced the odd black bear, raccoons, and even a cougar from time to time. You get to know the sounds of nature that are all around you. I can remember as a small boy, sitting around the campfire at night and hearing strange sounds in the not so far distance, followed by similar calls back in response. My dad would always tell us it was Bigfoot. Everyone would kind of laugh and go back to what they were doing. It was such a common occurrence that nobody really gave it a second thought. We were certainly never afraid of the sounds or even the thought of seeing a Bigfoot, as it was so familiar. My parents divorced in 1980. From that point on, It was only my dad and I that went up there. My dad had an injury later that year that put him on permanent disability, which meant that we were "free" to go camping as often as we wanted during the summer as he no longer had to go to work. title: Report 82512: Report # 82512
summary: Me and a couple of friends was riding a back road close to my house called River Road. We stopped and got out of our vehicles to look around at the lookout when we heard what sounded like a distant knock. We stood for about 20 seconds in dead silence. One of my friends said "Whistle or howl. It could be a Bigfoot." So Iet out a long whistle. We got a response back with what sounded like sticks or tree saplings being broken so we jumped back in the vehicles. We went further down the road so we could turn back around. On our way back we stopped again at the lookout to see if we could hear something. We wasnt going to get out this time. I shined a spotlight into the woods and was just looking. I seen around 40 yards away from the truck a black hairy figure that was so dark I couldnt see it until it moved. It was around 7 to 8 feet tall. Its back was turned to me but it slightly turned to us as if it was checking to see if we was still there. The outline of the face was ape like with the cone kinda shaped head and a yellowish green eye shine. At that moment I told my friend to get out of there. He floors it.

title: Report 82506: Report # 82506
summary: May 2024, we went camping up at the Skookumchuck Reservoir Dam outside Tenino Washington. It is private and discreet. The land is owned and controlled by TransAlta Corportion. You pass three security gates to get there. You need to have the keys that are given to you by the company.  It is completely isolated and it is special access to be able to go camping up there somebody you know has to work for the company. Huge liability form, etc. Nobody can even accidentally be up there. There are cameras at the entrance and security guards daily that drive through the area and around the reservoir. It is completely isolated from the outside world. The encounter occurred the first night we were up there. We were all in tents. There were five adults and three children spending the night. We all headed to bed about 11 oclock. About 45 minutes after we laid down I heard what I thought what was a man getting up to go take a pee. I did not hear his tent unzip, but I heard someone walking around. There is a port-a- potty about 60 yards away, but this person was walking in the opposite direction of the toilet.  After about 10 minutes of him walking around, it crossed my mind to go out there and check on him to see if he was OK. Thats when what  I thought was a person, walked in front of my tent about 5 ft away and I immediately knew something is off. My tent was 12 foot wide across the front. As it walked across the front of my tent something was off, but I wasnt sure what it was. As it walked past my tent a second time I realized that the stride was about 3 1/2 to 4 strides from end to end of my tent. I immediately had a gut wrench feeling that this was not human. I sat up quietly, halfway out of my sleeping bag, careful to not make any noise, and I grabbed my pistol. I went to wake my husband. He also heard the noise. summary: [Written by witness Terra Filmer-Larson]: I never thought to submit my sighting of Bigfoot until now, 20 years later. I believe it was the year 2006, I was an employee at Lake Crescent Lodge in Olympic National Park, WA. I was at employee housing talking to my mom on the phone. It was late in the day, around sunset, no one else was around. I was sitting on the back doorsteps looking out into the old growth forest. She said I was talking then all of a sudden said, "hmmm, what is thaaa....." then she heard me hyperventilating. She asked what was going on but I only whispered, "I can't move." She begged me to go inside. She said I was really hyperventilating and almost crying. I then ran and started to cry. I remember feeling sheer terror. The bigfoot wasn't very far away. It was walking very fast diagonally but not toward me. I didn't smell anything nor was there any sound. It was massive and the way it moved was very heavy as it swung its arms. The light was dim so I couldn't make out any other details. It never looked at me in the couple of seconds I was looking at it. I ran the opposite direction then I stopped, turned back around and was suddently curious, but it was already gone. My heart was beating so fast. And that's it. Only a couple seconds of seeing the bigfoot walking very fast. I will never know why I saw what I did but the memory will forever be with me and I feel pretty lucky. I don't like to share my encounter. I did a few times and people look at me like I'm crazy. I am not the kind of person to make up something like this. Some people asked me if it could have been a bear walking upright. Absolutely no way, I have been around a lot of bears and they can't walk like that. Anyways, my family believes me, and my mom. She absolutely loves it.

summary: Monday August 10, 2026 was my day off from work. I always like to plan some kind of outdoor, in the woods kind of adventure . Monday was a beautiful day for a hike . So I decided to go to a remote place in upstate New York.  I picked out a glacial pond and bog [in Onondaga County]. It was about 1pm when I arrived. I was the only one there. Not too surprising for a weekday afternoon. I walked out on the path to the take in the pond view. I took some video on the way out and then when I reached the pond I looked straight out and took a picture of the whole pond with the surrounding area. As I looked to the left I realized there was someone like wading in the pond. I was instantly unnerved and wondering what the heck was going on . I snapped a couple photos and it seemed to snap its head around and look right at me in such a strange way that I got creeped out even more. I just slowly turned the other way and started walking away in the opposite direction. I walked the back to the parking lot. I passed a family of three just arriving and starting their walk on the path. When I got back to the parking lot. I decided to walk the other path down to the pond's edge, closer to the spot where I had taken the photo to see if anyone was down there. There was no one down there. There was a sign posted that said no swimming or wadding though. There was also a small shoreline path in front of a patch of reeds that I started  to walk down but I got a really creepy feeling and decided to head back to the parking lot. Once I got close to the parking lot I discovered another trail leading into the woods and decided to check out this trail too. I walked a little ways down trail maybe a quarter mile but I didnt see anyone and I started to feel very creeped out so I turned around and went back to my car and went home. When I got home and started looking at my photos from the day I discovered that the photo of the person I had seen wading in the pond looked very odd and strange to me.
